metas.name: The Silence of Swastika
metas.description: Hitler used a symbol for his political and racial ideology. The world today calls that symbol "Swastika", an Indian name to a symbol used by Hindus, Buddhists, and Jains for ages. But was it a Swastika? or Something else?

metas.name: The Godfather
metas.description: The aging patriarch of an organized crime dynasty transfers control of his clandestine empire to his reluctant son.

metas.name: Hushar Pittalu
metas.description: In a village, two teenagers fall into a secret relationship, driven by curiosity and bad influences. As their families oppose them, the couple rebels, exposing how youthful attraction and parental mistakes can change lives forever.

metas.name: Modha Rathiri
metas.description: Follows two strangers brought together at an unusual wedding where, in one night, too many surprises unfold and several lies are told, spiraling into chaos that changes everything.

metas.name: Interstellar
metas.description: When Earth becomes uninhabitable in the future, a farmer and ex-NASA pilot, Joseph Cooper, is tasked to pilot a spacecraft, along with a team of researchers, to find a new planet for humans.

metas.name: Dhurandhar The Revenge
metas.description: Jaskirat Singh Rangi descends deeper into his alias as Hamza Ali Mazari, rising through Karachi's criminal hierarchy to claim the feared title "Sher-e-Baloch" while balancing loyalty, betrayal, and survival in a ruthless underworld.

metas.name: The Prestige
metas.description: Two friends and fellow magicians become bitter enemies after a sudden tragedy. As they devote themselves to this rivalry, they make sacrifices that bring them fame but, with terrible consequences.

metas.name: Sachin - A Billion Dreams
metas.description: A tale of a small boy with dreams and his journey to becoming the God of Cricket and the most celebrated sportsperson in his country.

metas.name: Good Will Hunting
metas.description: A therapist counsels Will Hunting, a janitor with a genius IQ.

metas.name: Dhurandhar
metas.description: A mysterious traveler slips into the heart of Karachi's underbelly and rises through its ranks with lethal precision, only to tear the notorious ISI-Underworld nexus apart from within.

metas.name: Agent Sai Srinivasa Athreya
metas.description: Agent Sai Srinivasa Athreya is an authentic humorous investigative thriller revolving around the adventures of a detective based out of Nellore.

metas.name: Dhuruvangal Pathinaaru
metas.description: A police officer retires after an accident during a case investigation. Years later, he is forced to relive the past as he narrates the story to his friend's son.

metas.name: Project Hail Mary
metas.description: A science teacher wakes up alone on a spaceship. As his memory returns, he uncovers a mission to stop a mysterious substance killing Earth's sun, and realizes that an unexpected friendship may be the key.

metas.name: Casino
metas.description: In Las Vegas, two best friends--a casino executive and a Mafia enforcer--compete for a gambling empire and a fast-living, fast-loving socialite.

metas.name: The Truman Show
metas.description: An insurance salesman begins to suspect that his whole life is actually some sort of reality TV show.

metas.name: Lubber Pandhu
metas.description: Set against the rural backdrop, explores gully cricket stars Gethu and Anbu's intense rivalry. Anbu's romantic involvement with Gethu's daughter escalates the clash. Their skills and emotions are put to the ultimate test.

metas.name: Rush
metas.description: James Hunt and Niki Lauda, two extremely skilled Formula One racers, have an intense rivalry with each other. However, it is their enmity that pushes them to their limits.

metas.name: Ayirathil Oruvan
metas.description: Anitha, a government official, embarks on a journey to find Chandramouli, an archaeologist, who went to Vietnam to search for any existence of the prince of the Chola dynasty.

metas.name: The Pursuit of Happyness
metas.description: A struggling salesman takes custody of his son as he's poised to begin a life-changing professional career.

metas.name: Karthikeya 2
metas.description: A sequel to Karthikeya (2014), which deals with the personal problems of Karthikeya and how his pursuit of the truth leads him to find out the power of Indian ancient system and Tatva of Lord Sri Krishna.

metas.name: Obsession
metas.description: Baron "Bear" Bailey breaks a novelty charm to force his co-worker Nikki Freeman to love him, but the supernatural compulsion warps her mind into violent obsession, trapping him in a nightmare he cannot wish away.

metas.name: Dor
metas.description: Two woman --different backgrounds, miles apart, and strangers to each other-- are linked by tragedy. Their new-found friendship is tested as one holds the fate of the other's husband in her hands.

metas.name: Aayitha Ezhuthu
metas.description: Three men and their accidental meeting on Napier Bridge will change their lives forever.

metas.name: Angamaly Diaries
metas.description: Vincent Pepe who wanted to be a powerful leader of a righteous gang that ruled the city, like his seniors. And then there's the rival clan with the malicious gangsters of Angamaly a locale on which the film is based.

metas.name: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
metas.description: A troubled child summons the courage to help a friendly alien escape from Earth and return to his home planet.

metas.name: Hidden Figures
metas.description: Three female African-American mathematicians play a pivotal role in astronaut John Glenn's launch into orbit while dealing with racial and gender discrimination.

metas.name: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish
metas.description: When Puss in Boots discovers that his passion for adventure has taken its toll and he has burned through eight of his nine lives, he launches an epic journey to restore them by finding the mythical Last Wish.

metas.name: Nanban
metas.description: 10 years after leaving college, two best friends and their rival go on a search for their third friend, while finding out some truths along the way.

metas.name: Rockstar
metas.description: Janardhan Jakhar chases his dreams of becoming a big Rock star, during which he falls in love with Heer.

metas.name: Aligarh
metas.description: A gay, linguistic professor living in a small orthodox city must deal with the aftermath of a sting operation that puts his sexual orientation in front of the entire nation.

metas.name: Ocean's Eleven
metas.description: Danny Ocean, a gangster, rounds up a gang of associates to stage a sophisticated and elaborate casino heist which involves robbing three Las Vegas casinos simultaneously during a popular boxing event.

metas.name: A Few Good Men
metas.description: A military lawyer intends to prove that two US Marines charged with murdering a fellow Marine were only following their base commander's orders.

metas.name: Primal Fear
metas.description: A high-profile murder intrigues a publicity hungry lawyer.

metas.name: G.D.N
metas.description: G.D. Naidu overcomes challenges and defies a repressive colonial regime to become one of India's greatest innovators.

metas.name: Hanu Man
metas.description: An imaginary place called Anjanadri where the protagonist gets the powers of Hanuman and fights for Anjanadri.

metas.name: Delhi Belly
metas.description: Three struggling room-mates unknowingly become potential prey of a ruthless gangster.

metas.name: Sanju
metas.description: Biopic of the controversial life of actor Sanjay Dutt: his film career, jail sentence, and personal life.

metas.name: Good Bad Ugly
metas.description: A fearless don tries to change his ruthless ways and violent past to live peacefully with his family. However, his dark past continues to haunt him. He faces it head-on and overcomes it.

metas.name: Seven Pounds
metas.description: A man with a fateful secret embarks on an extraordinary journey of redemption by forever changing the lives of seven strangers.

metas.name: Bheja Fry
metas.description: Ranjit, who makes fun of idiots, gets completely annoyed when he invites a tax inspector and a singer to his house.

metas.name: The Reader
metas.description: Post-WWII Germany: Nearly a decade after his affair with an older woman came to a mysterious end, law student Michael Berg re-encounters his former lover as she defends herself in a war-crime trial.

metas.name: Deool Band 2
metas.description: The story follows a farmer who decides to question and test his faith, setting off a journey filled with emotional and life-altering moments. At its core, the narrative centers on a woman who tirelessly struggles for her family, facing hardships with resilience, as her path ultimately leads her to confront the very idea of divine power

metas.name: Sinners
metas.description: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.

metas.name: Dil Se..
metas.description: A radio broadcaster's intense attraction to a mysterious woman opens the door to a tidal wave of powerful emotions and desires.

metas.name: Romancham
metas.description: A game of Ouija board goes hilariously wrong when seven bachelors unexpectedly invite a spirit and try to make the best out of the situation.

metas.name: Rakkasapuradhol
metas.description: Inspector Shiva an alcoholic officer struggling with schizophrenia, is transferred to Rakkasapura, a seemingly quiet village with a low crime rate. Soon The village’s peace is shattered by a series of gruesome murders. Young women are found dead, dressed in bridal finery with their faces charred beyond recognition. Witness as a troubled cop in rural India confronts his own demons while pursuing a complex case that tests his moral boundaries and beliefs.

metas.name: The Greatest Showman
metas.description: Celebrates the birth of show business and tells of a visionary who rose from nothing to create a spectacle that became a worldwide sensation.

metas.name: Promising Young Woman
metas.description: An unexpected encounter gives a wickedly smart woman a chance to right the wrongs from the past.

metas.name: Nocturnal Animals
metas.description: A wealthy art gallery owner is haunted by her ex-husband's novel, her memories of their relationship, and her regrets about her life.
